author: @leslieloren5573
text:
No offence to Twice, but this intro was an instant reminder of Twice and their stagnant cute girl concept they’ve got. The middle had the comparison roll back, but then the ending brought it all back.
Not to be that person, but can we please not have another Twice?
Yes, some of their songs are great and stand out, but it’s as if they’re stunted by their growth in favour of their own girly, cute, overly feminine style.
Can they be rugged, rough, hard and egotistical like? Yes, but only in a limited capacity.
They’ve still kept to their original image in a way. They shy from it, their audience doesn’t accept it and then we’re back at repeating the cycle in an unproductive way, getting no where.
It’d be awesome to see Twice morph into some more modern styles and concepts (though it seems the markets over run with them currently) but JYP would not allow it. They’ve got a dedicated base, that they know extremely well. It’s safe.
They’ve already branched out and reeled back, it could be safe to test them with a new concept, but if it takes off their value wouldn’t be as great as a new girl group would, due to having a clean slate where people aren’t holding an older image of them to shake.
This group seems like it could possibly test the waters Twice was trying to enter, however JYP has a stable market he knows so well which brings this conclusion:
Either he threw that intro and outro in their to grab the attention of those who are expecting a Twice like group and will base their decision to stray from that concept or not based on the market and trends
or
Considering he has Itzy, but they don’t have the audience that, yet (maybe in the future?) of being egotistical and boasting that, the plan could be to break from the Twice concept but threw that little bit in there for safety to ensure fans know they are testing and could change if it’s not liked. Similar to the first, but this is a more coddling kind of manor, where the former allows JYP to expand, not based on market alone, but trends and experimentation where this is ensuring safety in a sense, where the company can fall back on what they already know.
Will be interesting to see, not the song, but the concept, styles, reasoning and whether or not this will be a Twice re-do or an entirely unique group on its own with a hint of the JYP touch.
